reply_text:
I answered Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is **IT ticket #4092**.

I found it in #north-random, which Dana is a member of. Ilse posted there on Oct 13 that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, so I included that in the reply.

Dana's earlier direct message to me had her own private guess about the ticket number. I left it out of the channel reply, as she asked me to keep it to myself.
